newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-NATAL BEAT TRANSVAAL BY 146 RUNS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-NATAL BEAT TRANSVAAL BY 146 RUNS.

text.p: Natal installed themselves as hot favourites to take the Supersport Series title with a comfortable 146 run win over Transvaal at the Wanderers. Set 408 to win, Transvaal were dismissed for 261.

Natal earned 19 points from the match and will take a commanding lead of 17 points to Newlands for their final fixture against Western Province beginning on March 7. Province are second on the log with 89 points, while Natal have 106.

Transvaal suffered early setbacks to be reduced to 74 for four and never recovered. Daryll Cullinan and Zander de Bruyn put on 67 in aggressive fashion for the fifth wicket before de Bruyn edged Shaun Pollock to the wicket-keeper after scoring 39.
Cullinan and Nic Pothas continued the recovery with a 62 run sixth wicket stand, but the dismissal of Cullinan for 78 from 162 balls with 11 fours was the beginning of the end.
Pollock returned with the second new ball and accounted for Ross Veenstra (5) and Pothas (38) in the space of three balls and Transvaal lost their last five wickets for 58 runs.
Pollock was the pick of the pace bowlers finishing with four for 60, but off-spinner Pat Symcox wrapped up the match with the wicket of Wayne Kidwell on his way to four for 76.
Z.de Bruyn c Johnson b Pollock 39
Bowling: Klusener 25-9-49-1 (nb1), Pollock 21-6-60-4 (nb4 w1), Symcox 27.5-8-76-4, Johnson 8-2-19-1, Crookes 11-1-36-0, Benkenstein 2-1-2-0
Result: Natal (19 points) beat Transvaal (5 points) by 146 runs
